thread:
Maya: Quick sync — prepping v2 cutover timeline. Need owners for: docs freeze (2026-04-02), SDK beta (2026-04-09), feature-flag sunset (2026-05-01). Who can own SDK beta and the rollback runbook?
Devin: I can own SDK beta + release notes. I'll need eng-runtime to merge the compatibility shim PR. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321 :eyes:
Sasha: I'll own docs freeze. I'll create a checklist in the docs repo and add cross-links.
Nate: Oncall here — we need a clear rollback plan and SLIs. What are the error/latency thresholds to trigger rollback?
Liam: deploy-bot: Canary for /v2 endpoints started in us-east-1 (id: canary-2267). Smoke passed.
Maya: Rollback thresholds proposal: 3x error rate over baseline for 5m OR 20% p99 latency increase for 5m. Fallback plan: route to compatibility-shim (v1 adapter) for 24h, then manual rollback if no improvement. Devin add to runbook? :+1:
Devin: Yup adding now. Also pinging eng-runtime for PR review — we need the shim to support header mapping.
Devin: curl example for toggling canary:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/flags/canaries/2267/toggle -d '{"enable":true}'
```
Nate: For SLIs I'll monitor 5xx rate and p99. If I alert, who is primary?
Sasha: Docs owner here — add a line to runbook with the alert contact list.
Liam: eng-runtime (cc @eng-runtime) please review PR #4321 and confirm shim compatibility with model-routing.
eng-runtime: ack, will triage today.
Maya: Final ask: owners list and one-sentence ready state by EOD tomorrow. I'll consolidate and schedule the cutover. Thanks everyone :rocket:
